firstMessage.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm trying to load the NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Nano-30B model on Kaggle using trust_remote_code=True, but I keep running into the following error:

*ImportError: mamba-ssm is required by the Mamba model but cannot be imported * What I’ve already tried:

Installing mamba-ssm and causal-conv1d via pip Using --no-build-isolation Installing into /kaggle/working and updating PYTHONPATH Restarting the session after installation

However, the issue persists. It seems that Kaggle’s environment may not fully support building these dependencies (possibly due to Triton/CUDA constraints).

My questions:

Is there a reliable way to run Nemotron models on Kaggle without hitting mamba_ssm errors? Is there a workaround or alternative version of the model that does not depend on Mamba? Has anyone successfully trained a LoRA adapter for this model on Kaggle?

Any help or shared experience would be greatly appreciated 🙏
